lines.text: Has a trading on/off switch (openTrading()). Before it is on, you may be able to buy but not sell.

12 more function(s) Neuro cannot name (0x0cdbd4e2, 0x0faee56f, 0x456cb7c6, 0x5874d8fd, 0x62256589, 0x91dd7346, 0xa42f786e, 0xb7d67708, 0xbf474bed, 0xca703075, 0xe41032d9, 0xfcd0598b), so what they do is unknown. While an owner still controls the contract, they may be privileged, e.g. setting a tax or trading limits.
